Maxx page (tjx.com/businesses/united-states/tj-maxx): 'TJ Maxx was founded in 1976'; 'the largest off-price retailer of apparel and home fashions in the U.S.'; brands 'for way less'; 'brand-name fashion to home decor'; 'an expanded assortment of jewelry, accessories'; 'the Runway at TJ Maxx' is 'our exclusive department that brings you high-end luxury at an amazing value', 'in select stores'; e-commerce site tjmaxx.com 'launched in 2013'; 'stores across the country, including Puerto Rico'.

Wikipedia (TJ_Maxx, read 2026-10-29): founded 1976, Framingham, Massachusetts (infobox); headquarters Framingham; parent TJX (1987–present); first two stores 1977 in Worcester and Auburn, MA [5]; 1,333 locations (infobox, Statista [1]); infobox products include clothing, footwear, jewelry, beauty products.
